hook: How is Charlemagne connected to Rin Itoshi?
title: Charlemagne to Rin Itoshi: how?
description: A Raphael fresco, 170 popes, a Vatican audience and Expo 2025 link the first Holy Roman Emperor to Blue Lock's Rin Itoshi.

links.line: In 800, Pope Leo the Third crowned Charlemagne, a scene Raphael's workshop painted.
Over 12 centuries, 170 more popes followed Leo, down to Pope Francis.

links.line: In 2022, Pope Francis received Japan's prime minister Fumio Kishida at the Vatican.

image.credit: Japan Association for the 2025 World Exposition, via Keidanren Times

links.line: That July, Kishida counted down to Expo 2025 with its chairman, Masakazu Tokura.

image.credit: Japan Association for the 2025 World Exposition, via Kyodo News PR Wire

links.line: In 2023, Tokura launched Expo ticket sales with Fantastics singer Yusei Yagi.

pair.credit: Blue Lock film (Toho / Kodansha), via Cinema Today

links.line: And in 2026, Yagi starred as Blue Lock's Rin Itoshi.
